verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents API keys used as Basic Auth credentials, along with account listing and ACH, wire, and book transfers. Nothing in the pack shows scoped or least-privilege credentials, per-key amount caps, counterparty allowlists, or any vendor-named agent use case. The Card Auth Loop lets a developer accept or reject card transactions with their own logic, but that is an adjacent building block, not policy-scoped agent credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
